name: Divymm Drone (CR 1)
body:
Divymm Drone
CR 1

XP 400
N Medium construct
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 11, flat-footed 10 (+1 Dex)
hp 16 (3d10)
Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +4; +2 vs. mind-affecting effects, nausea, sickening, sleep, stunning
Defensive Abilities hardness 2; Immune sentient construct traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +4 (1d6+1)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 12, Con —, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 9
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 15
Feats Great Fortitude, Iron Will
Skills Craft (mechanical) +10, Diplomacy +5, Disable Device +10, Knowledge (engineering) +10; Racial Modifiers +2 Craft, +2 Disable Device, +4 Knowledge (engineering)
Languages Ancient Patron, Common
SQ construction points (1), modifications (slam), offline reverie, repair, sentient construct, unity lifeforge

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or gestalt (3-8)
Treasure NPC gear (masterwork mechanical artisan’s kit, masterwork thieves tools, other gear)
